newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Menem names associate to Justice post.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Menem names associate to Justice post.

text.p: President Carlos Menem Thursday named Raul Granillo Ocampo, currently Argentina's ambassador to the United States, as the new justice minister.
Menem said the 49-year old Granillo Ocampo, a long-time associate, will replace Elias Jassan, who quit after being caught lying about phone calls from an alleged mobster.
Like Menem, Granillo Ocampo is from the arid province of La Rioja in western Argentina, and he presided over the provincial Supreme Court when Menem was governor in the 1980s.
Menem named Granillo Ocampo his official legal advisor in 1991, and he was rewarded with the Washington embassy two years later.
His term as ambassador has been viewed as successful in improving relations with the United States.

Granillo used his post to stay in the Argentine headlines and was often involved in long distance sniping matches with former Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo. ((-Jason Webb, Buenos Aires newsroom, 541 318-0655))
